description: "Though its scent lingers, the flower's form has long since scattered. Such is the transience of life; such is ephemeral beauty."
summon:
To be ephemeral, to be transient—that is life.
But to be here, to meet you in this exact moment—that is fate.
fusion: Everything will be, as it should be.
evolution:
So you too...
A brilliant, unworldly thing...
